skills.name: Ninjutsu: Demon Feast
skills.description:
Every 5 basic attacks by Hanzo <font color='#404495'>(temporarily unlocks)</font> this ability for 6.5s.
Hanzo uses Ame no Habakiri to devour a target and digest them over a period of time. By doing so Hanzo gets 10 <font color='#404495'>(Demon Blood)</font>. (Can only be used against Minions and Creeps. Targeting Lord or Turtle deals 500 <font color='#E5CB19'>(True Damage)</font>).
skills.tips: This skill provides powerful jungling ability for Hanzo. If the Attack Speed is fast enough, each attack of Hanzo can unlock two stacks.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Soul Reap
skills.description:
Hanzo summons demonic spikes at the target location, dealing 160<font color='#D58E1F'>( +60% Total Physical Attack)</font> immediate <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>.
If an enemy is hit, the skill will strike again after 0.5s, dealing 40<font color='#D58E1F'>( +15% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to targets in the area and slowing them by 40% until no target is hit or dealing additional damage for 8 times.
Every unit hit grants him 1 <font color='#404495'>(Demon Blood)</font>.
skills.tips: This skill ensures the laning ability of Hanzo, try to make full use of it when Hanzo takes back the area in order to obtain Demon Blood faster

skills.name: Kinjutsu: Pinnacle Ninja
skills.description:
Hanzo gains 25 Demon Blood and sends out the demon <font color='#404495'>(Hanekage)</font> in the target direction while gaining a new set of skills.
<font color='#404495'>(Hanekage)</font> consumes 10 <font color='#404495'>(Demon Blood)</font> every second while he is out. Hanzo's body will be slowly pulled to Hanekage's location as Demon Blood depletes. <font color='#404495'>(Hanekage)</font> can move through terrain and gains 35% Movement Speed and 30% Attack Speed, but his Physical & Magic Defense are reduced by 50.0%.
If <font color='#404495'>(Hanekage)</font> is killed, he will be drawn back to Hanzo's body, stunning Hanzo for 3s and weakening him for 8s (slowing him by 55%, reducing his Physical & Magic Defense by 100%, and revealing his location to enemies). If <font color='#404495'>(Hanzo's body)</font> is killed, he will die immediately and Hanekage will disappear.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body (the additional skill button will summon Hanzo's body to Hanekage instead).
skills.tips: Try to hide Hanzo's body in the safe area. When facing Hanzo, to find his body and kill him is also a good way to counter him.

skills.name: Ame no Habakiri
skills.description:
When units die near Hanzo, the demon Hanekage absorbs their souls and converts them into <font color='#404495'>(Demon Blood)</font>.
Hanzo gains 2 <font color='#404495'>(Demon Blood)</font> for each non-hero unit and 20 <font color='#404495'>(Demon Blood)</font> for each hero that dies in his vicinity.
skills.tips: Even when Hanzo is in a defensive status, he can also recover Demon Blood depending on his Passive. The sufficiency of Demon Blood is a must for Hanzo to perform attack or escape.

items.name: Blade of the Heptaseas
items.des: Unique Passive - Ambush: If no damage is taken or dealt within 5s (excluding from Minions or Creeps), the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 160 <1025 0.4> Physical Damage and slow the target by 40% for 1.5s.

items.name: Ice Hunter's Swift Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Hunter: After dealing damage to a Creep, deal 25<2|lv 3> + <1005 0.01> True Damage to the target over 3s (damage is increased by 100% for non-Marksmen heroes).

items.name: Hunter Strike
items.des: Unique Passive - Retribution: Dealing damage to the same enemy hero or creep 5 times in a row grants 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3s (8s cooldown).

items.name: Endless Battle
items.des: Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: We recommend these three sets of euipment items, Among which the third set is highly recommended as Hanzo has a good ability of farming in the jungle with his skills and the third set improves his ability to gank.
